# MorphDelta

One morph-target vertex delta: offsets added to the bind-pose position and
normal, scaled by the target's weight at runtime.

## Parameters

- `position`: An array of 3 floats. Position offset `[x, y, z]` in model space.
- `normal`: An array of 3 floats. Normal offset; the deformed normal is re-normalised after adding it.
